claude_proposed_widenings.name: suppress_spellcasting
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No existing atom prevents creatures from casting spells or taking Magic actions within an area. grant_extra_action / scale_attack_count are additive grants, not prohibitions. block_targeting addresses spell targeting, not the act of casting.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: No one can cast spells, take Magic actions, or create other magical effects inside the aura

claude_proposed_widenings.name: suppress_magic_item_properties
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No atom suppresses the active magical properties of magic items. This is distinct from block_targeting (which is about what can be targeted) and from grant_condition_immunity.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Magical properties of magic items don't work inside the aura or on anything inside it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: suppress_ongoing_spells
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: end_ongoing_spells terminates spells permanently. Antimagic Field suppresses them — the spell pauses without ending, and its duration continues ticking down. On leaving the aura the spell resumes. This suppression semantic is absent from the surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Ongoing spells, except those cast by an Artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the area. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn't function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: block_magic_area_ingress
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: block_targeting covers creatures/things being targeted, but no atom prevents external magical areas of effect from extending into a protected region.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Areas of effect created by spells or other magic can't extend into the aura
